company.shortDescription: Forterra delivers autonomous mission systems for defense.
company.description: Forterra delivers autonomous mission systems for defense. From self-driving land systems to coordinated swarms of robotic platforms, the company builds scalable, robust, mission-critical hardware and software designed to empower customers to deploy autonomy as a force multiplier - extending reach, survivability, and effectiveness across the battlespace and industrial domains.

aiResearchSummary.text: Robotic Research is engaged in developing systems for autonomous and semi-autonomous vehicle operations, including trailer assessment and maneuvering, driver aid and autonomous tractor-trailer parking and loading dock alignment, region focusing radar, autonomous gladhands coupling, and convoy management. Their work also covers detection and ranging sensor stabilization, intersection coordination for autonomous vehicles, and enhanced inertial navigation. These areas collectively advance transportation safety, security, and effectiveness.
